review_text: Exceptional Darjeeling aroma! Authentic taste and leaves unfurl nicely in boiling water.
Very refreshing morning green tea. No bitter aftertaste at all.
Great quality and healthy organic packaging. A bit pricey but worth it.
Best green tea on the market. Repeat purchase for my family.
Fresh fragrant leaves, tin container keeps it airtight. Good product.
Audio quality is crisp with punchy bass, fits comfortably in ear.
Battery life is terrible compared to advertised 20 hours. Barely lasts 2 hours on full charge!
Disappointed with the battery. Drains from 100% to 20% in just 45 minutes of conference calls.
Sound is decent, but left earbud battery drains much faster than the right one.
Charging case stopped holding battery charge after only two weeks of light usage.
Design and bluetooth connectivity are sleek, mic is clear enough.
Defective battery backup! It suddenly powers off mid-song without low battery warning.
Poor battery life ruins what would otherwise be a nice sounding headphone. Avoid until fixed.
Case heats up during charging and earbuds only give 90 minutes playback. Very unhappy.
Battery drops rapidly while gaming or watching videos. Manufacturer needs to fix battery quality.
Accurate step counter and heart rate tracking. Bright display even in daylight.
Good features but silicone strap feels flimsy and causes sweating.
Sleep tracker and notification alerts work smoothly on Android.
Mobile app synchronization takes multiple attempts to connect via Bluetooth.
Decent battery lasts 4 days. Satisfactory fitness tracker for this price segment.
Keeps cold water chilled for over 24 hours in hot weather! Outstanding insulation.
High grade 304 stainless steel. Completely leakproof lid, doesn't spill in gym bag.
Solid powder coated matte finish. Easy to hold and clean. Highly recommended.
Durable construction, survived multiple drops with zero dents.
Excellent heat retention for hot soup and coffee. Superior build quality.
Sturdy canvas material with vintage leather accents. Looks classy for weekend trips.
Very spacious main compartment with dedicated shoe pocket. Good craftsmanship.

Heavy duty fabric and strong shoulder strap. Premium feel though a bit heavy.
